summary: Frontend-only visual/layout testing of office admin (office@educonnect.app) at 390x844 and 1920x800 on /, /students, /leads, /attendance, /messages, /settings, plus a super admin regression check. Office admin: all requested fixes PASS. No horizontal overflow on any page (scrollWidth=390 on mobile, 1920 on desktop). On mobile, office-highlights spans 16-374px. Bottom nav = home, crm, add, students, messages (no Clients), and the sidebar has no Clients either. Attendance tabs sit in one left-aligned row that scrolls sideways (nowrap, flex-start, scrollWidth 443 > 358). The topbar subtitle shows 'ZELIX VENTURES', not 'INR'. On desktop, Trending + Team are on the left and the inbox cards are on the right, with no big gap under Trending, and the Admissions tab content is spaced properly. REGRESSION FOUND: on super admin mobile, the Overview scrolls sideways (scrollWidth 548 on a 390 viewport) and the Trending cards are cut off at the right edge. The Clients bottom nav item is still there and works. Console: only the expected 401 on /api/auth/me before login.

ui_bugs.issue: Page scrolls sideways: scrollWidth 548px on a 390px viewport, and trending-row/team-strip extend to 548px. Root cause: the section at Dashboard.jsx line 205 has no grid-cols-1 and its children have no min-w-0, so the auto grid track grows to fit the TeamStrip carousel's content. Fix: use 'grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_340px]' and add min-w-0 to both child divs (lines 206 and 210), the same fix already applied in OfficeDashboard. Applying minmax(0,1fr) + min-w-0 in the browser brought scrollWidth back to 390. Line 175 (dashboard-hero) should also get grid-cols-1.

Scroll arrows appear whenever there are more than 3 members, even when nothing overflows. On office admin desktop, 5 cards fit easily and both arrows still show. The left arrow (absolute left-0 top-[30px]) also covers the first member card's avatar on both mobile and desktop. Fix: show the arrows only when scrollWidth > clientWidth, and add side padding (px-8) to the scroller or put the arrows outside the cards.

ui_bugs.component: Office Overview stat card 'Staff on roster'
ui_bugs.issue: Shows 0 while the Team strip on the same page lists 5 members (Adhish, Administrator, Blaise Jose, Office Admin, TEST Att Staff). The two numbers don't match. Check the staff_count source.

issues: At first load, the bottom-nav FAB (+) sits on top of the large 'Check In / press & hold' button. The user has to scroll before they can press Check In comfortably.
Topbar title is cut to 'Attendance ...'. Use the shorter title 'Attendance' on mobile.
Content is narrower (~940px) than other pages (~1160px), which leaves an uneven empty area on the right.
Calendar day cells are very large (~125px squares), so the month grid runs far below the fold.
The Inbox/Sent and All/Announcements/Reminders chips wrap onto 2 rows ('Reminders' sits alone on the second row). Use one horizontally scrollable row, like the Attendance tabs.
In the Today's Campus Visits header, the title is cut to 'Today's Campu...' and the date '2026-10-25' wraps onto 2 lines.
The form card only fills the left ~550px and the right half of the content area is empty. Consider a 2-column layout or a centered max width.
The topbar shows the office switcher 'All' for office_admin, who is limited to the KM_BLR office. Check whether it should be hidden or show the fixed office.
Content starts at x=247 while the topbar title starts at x=111, so the page heading doesn't line up with the topbar 'Workspace / Overview' label. Minor.

action_items: HIGH: Dashboard.jsx line 205-210: add grid-cols-1 and min-w-0 on the overview-highlights children to fix the super admin mobile overflow (548px)
TeamStrip: show the scroll arrows only when content overflows, and stop the left arrow covering the first card
Attendance mobile: add bottom padding / reposition so the FAB doesn't cover the Check In button
Messages mobile: keep the filter chips in one horizontally scrollable row
Office Overview: make 'Staff on roster' match the team count
Minor: shorten the CRM visits header on mobile, make the Attendance desktop width match other pages, use the Settings desktop whitespace better
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx (1133 lines) is far above the 700-line guideline; split it into per-role dashboard modules
TeamStrip arrow visibility uses members.length > 3 instead of measuring overflow

success_rate.frontend: 86% (6/7 requested checks pass; super admin mobile overview regression)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login form uses input[type=email]/[type=password] + Enter. The overflow check JS compares documentElement.scrollWidth with innerWidth. Office admin fixes verified. Re-check super admin / at 390px after the Dashboard.jsx grid-cols-1/min-w-0 fix.
rca of the issue: Super admin overflow: a CSS grid with no explicit columns on mobile gets an implicit auto track. Its min-content width comes from the TeamStrip's non-wrapping flex carousel (shrink-0 cards), so the track grows to 532px. minmax(0,1fr) + min-w-0 lets the overflow-x-auto scroller clip instead. Repro: log in as admin@educonnect.app at 390x844; document.documentElement.scrollWidth = 548.
